name: typescript-oauth-server
description: Headless TypeScript OAuth/OIDC Authorization Server built on Authlete 3.0. Works paired with auth-ui

paragraphs: The headless OAuth/OIDC Authorization Server in the Externalized Login & Consent pattern: a thin client of Authlete 3.0 on the inside, a standard OAuth/OIDC surface on the outside, with login and consent handed off to a separate UI (auth-ui).
The AS is the headless half of the pair — every screen a user sees during sign-in or consent is rendered by auth-ui. The AS owns only protocol endpoints and the redirect back to the RP.
features: Implementation-portable. A thin Authlete client with no user state can be this Node service, a sidecar, a reverse-proxy plugin, or live inside an API gateway / edge worker.
Authentication and consent evolve in auth-ui — MFA, passkeys, federation, step-up, per-claim consent, RAR — none of which the AS ever sees.
Independent deploy and scale. Two services, one narrow protocol between them.
